notes: The San Francisco City Planning Commission's minutes of its regular and special meetings, July to December 1976, from volume 33 of the San Francisco Public Library's deposit at the Internet Archive (33minutesofsanfran1976san). Pages were split from the hOCR search text on the Internet Archive page index, counting the viewer page among the leaves scandata.xml does not mark addToAccessFormats=false, and every page is dated from the meeting header it sits under. Four kinds of finding: what the Commission decided about a property, dated to the meeting that decided it; what the minutes state stood on or occupied the property; dated past facts the minutes state about a building; and landmark actions. A proposal on its own is not a finding. A Board of Supervisors or Board of Permit Appeals action the minutes report without its own date is framed 'by' the date of the meeting that reported it. The minutes name applicants, owners, attorneys, objectors, commissioners and staff throughout; the reader spec (in research/sources/sf-planning-commission-minutes.md, under Reader spec) barred all of them from every field, and kept companies, institutions, named buildings and architects.

coverage.remaining: Every page of volume 33 (33minutesofsanfran1976san, July-December 1976) was read. Next: volume 34 (1977), then 35-39 (1977-1980) and 40-58 (1994-2005).
coverage.note: 525 OCR pages with text out of 590 viewer pages (592 scanned leaves), read in one session by a single reader with no sub-agents; 30 meetings (23 regular, 7 special) from 1 July to 22 December 1976, each dated from its own header. 140 findings: 71 planning decision, 55 occupancy, 8 site history, 6 designation.
